summary: The F22 loader fix mirrors blog.ts and skips nothing production-discoverable; the F24 hero fix discriminates the custom 'to' stop; no tutor-commission K file changed. One real false pass: the contrast helper trusts jsdom's computed background-color, which pre-resolves var() from the :root token map and ignores an ancestor's inline custom property override, so a correctly-cased parent override does not change the colour the ratio is computed from. ADV-15 routes to Green with a committed failing test.
blocking_findings: ADV-15 [Blocker] adversarial: the contrast helper computes the ratio from the wrong colour when an ancestor overrides a colour token inline. readBackgroundLayer in src/__tests__/fixtures/contrast.ts reads window.getComputedStyle(element).backgroundColor; jsdom pre-resolves var(--color-slate-900) to the :root value rgb(15, 23, 42) even when the parent's inline style sets --color-slate-900: #ff0000, and a mechanism probe showed getComputedStyle(child).getPropertyValue('--color-slate-900') returns #ff0000 while getComputedStyle(child).backgroundColor returns rgb(15, 23, 42). A component that fixes contrast through an inline token override on a wrapper passes the contrast check with the un-overridden colour. Route-to-Green: resolve var() from the element cascade (cascaded background-color plus effectiveCustomProperty) instead of the pre-resolved computed value. The committed probe src/__tests__/contrast-parent-override.adversarial.test.tsx fails its ADV-15 case until the fix lands; its two held cases (case-variant ignored, var() fallback used) stay as armor.
nonblocking_findings: ADV-16 [Note] adversarial: the loader filter mirrors blog.ts. markdownSlugs filters readdirSync(directory) by file.endsWith(".md") and the loader lists every regular file including dotfiles and parses only .md, so nothing production-discoverable is skipped; the loader also sees directories under posts/ that production ignores (blog.ts iterates SUPPORTED_LOCALES only), which is the harmless second kind.
evidence: A temporary probe proved the mechanism: with the parent style set to --color-slate-900: #ff0000, getComputedStyle(child).getPropertyValue returns #ff0000 while getComputedStyle(child).backgroundColor returns rgb(15, 23, 42) and readBackgroundLayer returns {r:15, g:23, b:42}.
The committed probe at e9ccdac5e fails the ADV-15 case (expected 255, received 15) and passes the case-variant and fallback cases.

A temporary edit of hero-section.test.tsx changed the custom gradient to to-white; 'replaces the default gradient with a custom gradient' failed with '--tw-gradient-to: expected var(--color-white) to be var(--color-fuchsia-500)'; git checkout -- restored the file.
git diff --name-only 8a126f612..HEAD on the seven tutor-commission files is empty.
blog.ts line 84 filters readdirSync by file.endsWith(".md"); the loader lists every regular file per locale directory and parses only .md files, so dot-prefixed .md posts are seen by both.

ratings.evidence: The loader and hero fixes hold, but the contrast helper computes from the :root token when an ancestor overrides a token inline (contrast-parent-override.adversarial.test.tsx fails 1 of 3).
The F22 and F24 fixes answer their acceptance findings; the contrast helper resolves per element for the cases it sees but trusts jsdom's var() pre-resolution.
Every production edit was temporary and restored; the only commit adds one probe file.
The mechanism probe printed jsdom's split behavior (custom property #ff0000, backgroundColor rgb(15, 23, 42)).
